verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP explicitly supports streaming events onward via realtime destinations to CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), ad platforms, SaaS tools (Braze, Customer.io, Slack, PagerDuty), and generic webhooks (any HTTP endpoint), with filtering, transformation, testing, and monitoring built in (posthog-docs-9, posthog-docs-32, posthog-docs-34, posthog-intdir-1, posthog-intdir-2, posthog-supp-realtime-destinations). Batch exports also support scheduled exports to supported destinations. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of specific destination integrations working reliably in production, and no community corroboration of the CDP destinations feature specifically.
